name: CipherStream-J-Live
description: CipherStream Pro is a hybrid cryptographic application that bridges Java's high-performance backend with a Streamlit Data Science frontend. Unlike standard ciphers that only handle English text, this "Universal Vault" uses byte-level manipulation to secure anything from simple sentences to complex emojis and multi-language scripts.

paragraphs: CipherStream Pro is a hybrid cryptographic application that bridges a Java backend with a Streamlit frontend. Unlike basic ciphers that only handle English text, this "Universal Vault" works at the byte level, so it can process simple sentences, emojis, and multi-language scripts.
Note: This is an educational project. A byte-shift cipher is not secure by modern standards, so do not use it to protect sensitive data.
features: Hybrid architecture: A Python (Streamlit) interface calls a Java encryption engine.
Universal compatibility: Modulo 256 byte-shifting supports emojis 🚀, symbols, and non-English characters.
Frequency analysis dashboard: Plots how often each byte value occurs in the encrypted data.
Key files: Generates a unique .key file that is used to encrypt and decrypt your data.
Hexadecimal view: Shows the raw bytes of your data in hexadecimal.
